--- ## 🌟 Overview **AntiGravity Unreal Studio** transforms **Google Antigravity** into a full-scale, autonomous-capable AAA Unreal Engine development studio. Inspired by [Donchitos/Claude-Code-Game-Studios](https://github.com/Donchitos/Claude-Code-Game-Studios) and re-architected from the ground up specifically for **Google Antigravity's native customization engine** and **Unreal Engine 5.6 / 5.7 / 5.8 & Unreal Engine 6**, it proves two core capabilities out of the box: 1. **Greenfield Mastery (From Scratch to Playable):** Bootstrap a compilable C++20 `.uproject` (`/ue-scaffold`), generate procedural Blender greybox blockouts with `UCX_` convex collision (`/ue-prototype`), author data-driven GAS/StateTree/MassEntity systems (`/team-combat`, `/team-ai`, `/team-world`), and verify builds headlessly via `UnrealBuildTool` and Unreal Automation Tests. 2. **Brownfield Mastery (Audit, Refactor & Upgrade Existing Games):** Perform deep X-Ray audits of both C++/Verse source and binary `.uasset`/`.umap` packages via headless Unreal Python (`/ue-xray`), assess workflow compliance (`/adopt`), reverse-engineer missing GDDs/ADRs from code (`/reverse-document`), and refactor slow Blueprint Tick graphs into clean C++20 base classes (`/bp-to-cpp`). --- ## ⚡ Zero-Setup Quick Start ("Clone & Play") When you clone this repository and open it in **Google Antigravity** (on **Windows** natively, or inside **WSL2 / Linux / macOS**), `.agents/plugins.json` and `.agents/skills.json` automatically register all **22 agents**, **25 skills**, **6 lifecycle hooks**, and **MCP servers** with zero manual installation. ### 1. automatically via [`.agents/plugins/unreal-studio/mcp_config.json`](./.agents/plugins/unreal-studio/mcp_config.json): ### 1. `unreal-bridge-mcp` ([`mcp-servers/unreal-bridge-mcp/server.py`](./mcp-servers/unreal-bridge-mcp/server.py)) Zero-dependency Python MCP server that interfaces with your local Unreal Engine installations (`UE_5.6`, `UE_5.7`, `UE_5.8`, `Fortnite_Studio`/UEFN) on Windows or WSL2: - **`ue_bridge_status`** — Discovers all installed Unreal Engine versions, UBT/Editor binaries, and live Editor MCP port (`8000`) status. - **`ue_scaffold_project`** — Generates a complete `.uproject` (with `EnhancedInput`, `CommonUI`, `GameplayAbilities`, `ModularGameplay`, `StateTree`, `MassGameplay`, `PCG`, `PoseSearch`, `ChaosVehiclesPlugin`, and UE 5.8 `ModelContextProtocol`), `Source//` C++20 hierarchy, `DefaultEngine.ini` (Lumen, Nanite, Substrate, MegaLights), and a Smoke Automation Test. - **`ue_generate_cpp_class`** — Generates idiomatic UE 5.7/5.8/6.0 C++20 classes (`ActorComponent`, `PrimaryDataAsset`, `GameplayAbility`, `Actor`) obeying strict IWYU and `TObjectPtr` standards. - **`ue_compile_project`** — Invokes `UnrealBuildTool.exe` natively on Windows or across WSL2 and parses structured compiler errors and warnings. - **`ue_xray_project`** — Audits an existing Unreal project's C++/Verse source, `.uproject` plugins, `.uasset`/`.umap` counts, and C++ anti-patterns (unnecessary `bCanEverTick = true`, raw `UObject*` pointers). - **`ue_run_python_script`** — Executes `import unreal` Python scripts headlessly via `UnrealEditor-Cmd.exe -run=pythonscript -unattended -nullrhi` so binary `.uasset`/`.umap` assets are inspected or created safely through the engine's own reflection APIs. ### 2. `blender-studio-mcp` ([`mcp-servers/blender-studio-mcp/server.py`](./mcp-servers/blender-studio-mcp/server.py)) Zero-dependency headless Blender (`blender.exe -b --factory-startup -P`) MCP server: - **`blender_bridge_status`** — Verifies discovered Blender installation and headless execution readiness. - **`blender_normalize_for_unreal`** — Normalizes any 3D mesh (`.glb`, `.fbx`, `.obj`) to Unreal Engine conventions (`1 unit = 1 cm`, `+Z Up`, `-Y Forward`, bottom-center pivot at `(0,0,0)`), generates `UCX__01` convex collision hulls via `bmesh.ops.convex_hull`, and exports clean FBX. - **`blender_procedural_greybox`** — Generates parametric 3D greybox level blockouts (`cqb_room`, `city_block`, `cover_barrier`) with `UCX_` collision hulls for immediate Unreal level prototyping. ### 3. `meshy` AI 3D MCP Integration ([`/asset-pipeline`](./.agents/plugins/unreal-studio/skills/asset-pipeline/SKILL.md)) - Connects directly to the `meshy` MCP tools (`meshy_text_to_3d`, `meshy_image_to_3d`, `meshy_remesh`, `meshy_retexture`, `meshy_rig`, `meshy_animate`) using **`meshy-t2.5` Smart Topology** and pipes generated `.glb`/`.fbx`
